newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Resources details HKCB acquisition.
newsitem.headline: China Resources details HKCB acquisition.

text.p: China Resources Enterprises Ltd (CRE) said on Thursday it acquired 50 percent of Hongkong Chinese Bank Ltd and injected it into a new company set up with Lippo Ltd to hold their joint finance operations.

The joint venture company, Lippo CRE Financial Services Ltd, will be equally held by CRE and Lippo. It in turn will hold 74.4 percent of The HKCB Bank Holding Co Ltd, with the remaining 25.6 percent to be held by the public.
HKCB Holding will hold 100 percent of Hongkong Chinese Bank after the deals, plus 100 percent of Lippo Securities Holdings Ltd and 50 percent of Lippo Protective Life Insurance Co Ltd.
Under a shareholders' agreement between CRE and Lippo, the Lippo Group will continue to control HKCB Holding and Hongkong Chinese Bank.

CRE said it would pay a total of HK$2 billion, made up of a cash payment from internal resources of HK$1.27 billion and the issue of 28.29 million new CRE shares at HK$25.80 per share, to acquire its parent China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd's 50 percent interest in Hongkong Chinese Bank.
